open_items: The owner's check of the hosted Streamlit app after the night's pushes (owner_checks.json p2).
The Strength reference: the store's config row (recommended; scripts/upload_strength_reference.py --apply) or a secret. Until then the engine's Strength screen answers 409 strength_reference_missing.

Carried: the voice app's address; [voxplot_supabase] out of the health app's secrets; the image store (455.5 MB of the 0.5 GiB free on 2026-10-19, about 190 MB once the clean-up has run: check it before the next deploy); Supabase's 7-day pause (Phase 9: a keep-alive from the Worker's cron).
The engine's start is about 9 s; lazy imports are the lever if the phone's first open feels slow.
next_phase_may_rely_on: Every screen's data and action is an endpoint with a typed answer; the phone computes nothing and holds no training, readiness or safety rule.
Every chart arrives with its axes and one tap detail per point; every guided-flow position arrives walked in advance (steps), so a session runs offline from one GET.
Every save is idempotent on ids the phone mints once; a failed save answers 503 save_incomplete and the same body completes it.
Fixed screen text (headings, button words, static notes) is the phone's strings file; sentences that carry values come from the engine.
Until Phase 9 the Streamlit app is the background writer: the engine's sync, manual syncs and Oura login answer 409 not_the_writer.
